test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 09 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The average weight of 10 boys is 70 kg. But later, it was found that at two places the weight 54 kg was read as 44 kg and at one place weight 35 kg was read as 40 kg. Find the correct average weight (in kg) of the 10 boys.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net change in **Total Sum** = (Correct Values − Incorrect Values)

Net change = [2 × (54 − 44)] + [1 × (35 − 40)] = 20 − 5 = +15 kg

Correction in **Average** = Net Change ÷ Number of Boys = 15 ÷ 10 = 1.5 kg

**Correct Average** = Old Average + Correction = 70 + 1.5 = 71.5 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 71.5 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of **boys** (n) = 10

Initial **average weight** = 70 kg

Incorrect observations: 44 kg (twice) and 40 kg (once)

Correct observations: 54 kg (twice) and 35 kg (once)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/650c9324d9649bdfc9ee535345efc1711a8f36d8b248f2868b5b5be77bb1a3f0.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Initial Weight = 10 × 70 = 700 kg

⇒ Sum of correct weights = (54 × 2) + 35 = 108 + 35 = 143 kg

⇒ Sum of incorrect weights = (44 × 2) + 40 = 88 + 40 = 128 kg

⇒ Correct Total Weight = 700 − 128 + 143 = 715 kg

⇒ Correct Average Weight = 715 ÷ 10 = 71.5 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 71.5 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Correction in Mean

When one or more observations are misread, the correct mean is: New Mean = Old Mean + [(Sum of Correct Values − Sum of Incorrect Values) ÷ n].

Sum of Observations

Total Sum = Average × Number of Observations. This is the base for finding corrections in total weight or marks.

Weighted Average

Used when combining two groups: Combined Avg = (n₁x₁ + n₂x₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂), where n is count and x is average.</p
